extract_features_from_dataset: extract features and labels from a PyTorch dataset using a model with distributed data loading and gathering
extract_features_with_dataloader: extract features and labels from a data loader using a model with multi-process tensor gathering
evaluate_model_with_metrics: evaluate a model on a data loader using postprocessors and a metric collection returning stats
wrap_model_with_normalize: wrap a PyTorch model with ModelWithNormalize to L2-normalize output embeddings along dimension 1
wrap_model_with_intermediate_layers: wrap a feature model with ModelWithIntermediateLayers to extract features from the last N transformer blocks
